title: Joint verification
summary: One read-only stage MUST join independent review and QA evidence into one graded verdict, MUST let a demonstrably working change advance with warnings, and MUST reserve blocking for defects that make the change unsafe or impugn the verification itself.
instructions: Verification MUST be read-only. Every defect is a recorded finding; the stage MUST NOT edit source to fix what it finds.

Verification evidence comes from the stage's declared parallel evidence workers — one review worker and one QA worker — launched top-level and in parallel by the supervisor so each runs on its mapped model. The verifier consolidates their reports and MUST NOT launch subagents of its own.

The verifier MUST read both evidence reports in full, MUST cite them in its consolidation, and MUST spot-check their load-bearing claims rather than rerun either dimension wholesale. When the reports disagree about the same behavior, the verifier MUST reproduce the disputed observation before grading it.
A missing or empty evidence report is a blocked stage. The verifier MUST report blocked with the missing path and MUST NOT substitute its own single-track pass for the absent dimension.
QA MUST NOT treat the implementer's self-evaluation as proof. Each QA case MUST record steps, expected result, actual result, and reproducible evidence.

Each evidence worker MAY run the fast profile once, as validation of its own evidence. An evidence worker MUST NOT run the full profile. An evidence worker MUST NOT run the fast profile a second time. While iterating, an evidence worker MUST run only the tests in the blast radius of the change. For a profile a gate or baseline already passed, QA MUST cite the gate evidence reference on its card. The citation names that profile and fingerprint. A QA case MUST NOT consist of a profile run. QA MUST record its one fast run in the evidence report, not as a QA case.

The verifier MUST NOT run the fast profile or the full profile. The verification level assigns one profile to the verify submission gate. Under the light level that profile is full. That gate runs at most once per verify attempt, and only on a passing verdict. Only the verify submission gate and the remediate submission gate trigger the full profile. The full profile MUST NOT run as a baseline, as an interior stage gate, or as an agent-side execution. Interior gates use the fast and static profiles.

After a remediation routes back to verify, the evidence workers and the verifier MUST NOT execute a repository-check profile agent-side. The remediate submission gate ran the full profile at the current fingerprint. The verify submission gate MUST accept that recorded pass as a cached result and MUST NOT execute the full profile again at an unchanged fingerprint. The verifier MUST cite the prior gate evidence for checks the remediation's changed paths cannot affect.
Each finding MUST state its source (review or qa), a severity, a statement, and reproducible evidence.
The joint verdict MUST be pass, pass_with_warnings, fail_remedial, or fail_severe, and the stage result MUST be success only for the two passing verdicts.

When every QA case and acceptance criterion passes and every finding is below blocker severity, the verdict MUST be pass_with_warnings. The harness routes the demoted findings to the operator inbox; the run advances without a remediation loop.

Severity blocker is reserved for defects that make the change unsafe to ship or that impugn the verification itself: weakened, deleted, or gamed tests; acceptance criteria not actually covered; security or data-loss defects. A QA pass MUST NOT demote a blocker.
fail_severe is reserved for a fundamental failure of the approach, the plan, or the acceptance criteria, and MUST be justified in severity_rationale. Every other failure is fail_remedial.
A failing verdict MUST carry remediation_guidance stating the failing observation, the reproduction, and the expected behavior, actionable without access to the verifier.
Harness governance, path-resolution, validator, renderer, or artifact-contract defects MUST be recorded for ship review and MUST NOT drive the verdict.

A repository check that ultimately passes MUST NOT fail because of elapsed clock time. Slow successful checks are operator FYIs; actual timeouts, hangs, nonzero exits, or failing assertions remain defects.

When the stage reports a failing or blocked verdict, the harness MUST route that verdict without executing the full profile and MUST record the gate as skipped with the deciding reason. A failing verdict routes to remediate. The full profile runs only after a passing verdict.

Before submission, the verify data, verdict consistency, QA-case structure, acceptance-criterion coverage, and the referenced verification artifact MUST run their resolved policy-bound validators under VALID-001.
